1: # board-api — the unified write door
2: 
3: **Status:** deployed (card `nest-api-unified-mutation-service`, OPS trail
4: `docs/ssot/jobs/infrastructure/2026-10-23-board-api-unified-mutations.yml`).
5: Service: `chaba-board-api.service` on idc03, `127.0.0.1:8787`, tailnet front
6: `https://idc03.taila0626a.ts.net:10000` (Caddy strips `/apps/board-api/`).
7: 
8: ## Rule
9: 
10: **Watchers watch, one door writes.** Every mutation an agent needs — kanban
11: cards, WP lesson/nest_job CPTs, ada-cms-pages report pages, focus-inbox
12: entries — goes through board-api over HTTP. Agents and runners never hold
13: WP app passwords or mddb credentials; only the service host has
14: `~/.config/secrets/wp-boards.env`. Same reason Colab stays credential-free.
15: 
16: ## Endpoints (after prefix strip)
17: 
18: | Path | Body | Writes |
19: |---|---|---|
20: | `/card` | `{id?, title, column?, spec?, report?, action?, queue?, ...}` | new card YAML + commit |
21: | `/comment` | `{id, from, text}` | card comms append |
22: | `/request` | `{id, ask, options?, suggested?, to?}` | card `requests[]` |
23: | `/respond` | `{id, request_id?, answer|option}` | answer a request/ask |
24: | `/action` | `{id, do: queue|close|hold|retry|claim|move|finish}` | card state |
25: | `/pipeline` | `{id, opt_in?|pipeline?|stage+status}` | CI status block |
26: | `/patch-relay` | `{id, head, branch?, bundle}` | git bundle spool |
27: | **`/lesson`** | `{topic, content, level?, source?, next_review?, status?, no_th?, from?}` | WP `lesson` CPT upsert by slug `lesson-<md5(topic)>` + auto-Thai section |
28: | **`/job`** | `{slug, title?, status?, comms?|note?, parent?, kind?, host?, pack?, runner?, result_ref?, error?, meta?}` | WP `nest_job` CPT upsert (ada-nest queue mirror) |
29: | **`/report`** | `{query}` \| `{slug, note, lang?}` \| `{title|slug, content_md, meta?}` | ada-cms-pages search / session-log append / create |
30: | **`/inbox`** | `{text, label?, priority?, tags?, missing_info?, subtasks?, session?, owner?, safe_to_parallel?}` | `docs/ssot/focus-inbox/<ts>-<slug>.yml` + commit |
31: | **`/publish`** | canonical `PublicationEvent` (below) \| `{op:"sinks"}` \| `{op:"drain"}` | fan-out to sink adapters: `job`/`lesson`/`report`/`news`/`telegram`/`board`/`json` |
32: 
33: ## Endpoint notes
34: 
35: - **`/job`** — `status` ∈ `queued|claimed|running|done|failed|stalled|
36:   cancelled`; `comms`/`note` appends `{at,from,text}` to a JSON log in
37:   `meta.comms` (cap 200); `parent` accepts a post id or a sibling job slug
38:   (job trees). `from` accepts actors or daemon/host names (`queue-mgr`,
39:   `tony-dell`). queue-mgr on dell mirrors `gdrive:ada-nest` queue/packs
40:   state through this — Colab workers and watchers never write.
41: - **`/lesson`** — same semantics old `scripts/lesson-add.py` had (which is
42:   now a thin CLI client of this endpoint): upsert by topic slug,
43:   `learned_at`/`next_review`/`status` preserved on re-file, Thai section
44:   appended unless `no_th` (gemini flash-lite, best-effort — a translation
45:   failure returns EN-only, never a failed write).
46: - **`/report`** — the report-integration duty: `mode` optional, inferred
47:   from fields. `query` → candidate slugs; `slug+note` → session-log append
48:   (reuses `cms-report-note.py` logic — managed block + writer-contract
49:   meta merge + index regen); `title+content_md` → create a new page.
50: - **`/inbox`** — lands a `docs/ssot/focus-inbox/` YAML in the TEMPLATE
51:   shape; runs under the card flock with the same atomic-write +
52:   immediate-commit discipline as cards.
53: 
54: ## /publish — the provider-neutral publication door
55: 
56: `POST /publish` takes one canonical `PublicationEvent` and fans it out
57: to registered sink adapters (`scripts/board/publication.py`). The
58: legacy endpoints are the compatibility adapters onto the same provider
59: writes — `/publish` routes through `do_job`/`do_lesson`/`do_report`
60: themselves, so WP is only one adapter and any second sink receives the
61: same event. Agents still never call WP REST or hold credentials.
62: 
63: **Event:** `kind` (progress|milestone|report|lesson|news|alert),
64: `title`, `source` (producer, required), `body` (required for
65: lesson/report/news), `project`/`job`/`card` refs, `parent`,
66: `evidence[]` (required for `news`), `confidence`
67: (observed|measured|verified — `public` news requires `verified`),
68: `visibility` (private|members|public — **private-first default**),
69: `audience[]`, `media[]`, `occurred_at`, `event_id`,
70: `idempotency_key` (auto-derived if absent — identical events dedupe),
71: `sinks[]` (explicit subset; else kind defaults), `force`, `meta{}`
72: (provider extras: `job_status`, `topic`, `level`, `report_slug`,
73: `tg_thread_id`, …).
74: 
75: **Kind → sinks (defaults):**
76: 
77: | kind | sinks | note |
78: |---|---|---|
79: | progress | `job`, `board` | heartbeat-class: throttled, never TG |
80: | milestone | `job`, `board`, `telegram` | |
81: | report | `report`, `board` | dossier needs `project` slug |
82: | lesson | `lesson` | Education CPT |
83: | news | `news`, `board`, `telegram` | evidence required |
84: | alert | `telegram`, `board`, `job` | |
85: 
86: **Guards:** idempotent on `idempotency_key` (deduped replies carry the
87: stored receipts); outbox under `~/.local/state/board-api-publish/`
88: retries failed sinks (30s×2ⁿ ≤30m, dead-letter after 5); capability
89: checks per sink (`{op:"sinks"}` reports surfaces/kinds/evidence);
90: noise policy throttles progress per (sink,topic) 15m, telegram floor
91: 10m/topic, identical alerts 60s (`force:true` bypasses noise only —
92: never visibility); visibility gates sinks by surface class (private →
93: board+json only; members → +WP private posts/TG; public → +publish
94: status). Receipts are per-sink `delivered|queued|skipped|suppressed`
95: with reasons — a `502` still means the door itself failed.
96: 
97: State: `$BOARD_API_PUB_STATE` (default `~/.local/state/board-api-publish/`):
98: `delivered.json`, `events.jsonl` (ledger), `outbox.jsonl`, `dead.jsonl`,
99: `noise.json`. Env: `PUB_TELEGRAM_URL`, `PUB_PROGRESS_MIN_S`,
100: `PUB_TG_MIN_S`, `PUB_ALERT_MIN_S`.

- **`/job`** — `status` ∈ `queued|claimed|running|done|failed|stalled|
  cancelled`; `comms`/`note` appends `{at,from,text}` to a JSON log in
  `meta.comms` (cap 200); `parent` accepts a post id or a sibling job slug
  (job trees). `from` accepts actors or daemon/host names (`queue-mgr`,
  `tony-dell`). queue-mgr on dell mirrors `gdrive:ada-nest` queue/packs
  state through this — Colab workers and watchers never write.
- **`/lesson`** — same semantics old `scripts/lesson-add.py` had (which is
  now a thin CLI client of this endpoint): upsert by topic slug,
  `learned_at`/`next_review`/`status` preserved on re-file, Thai section
  appended unless `no_th` (gemini flash-lite, best-effort — a translation
  failure returns EN-only, never a failed write).
- **`/report`** — the report-integration duty: `mode` optional, inferred
  from fields. `query` → candidate slugs; `slug+note` → session-log append
  (reuses `cms-report-note.py` logic — managed block + writer-contract
  meta merge + index regen); `title+content_md` → create a new page.
- **`/inbox`** — lands a `docs/ssot/focus-inbox/` YAML in the TEMPLATE
  shape; runs under the card flock with the same atomic-write +
  immediate-commit discipline as cards.

## /publish — the provider-neutral publication door

`POST /publish` takes one canonical `PublicationEvent` and fans it out
to registered sink adapters (`scripts/board/publication.py`). The
legacy endpoints are the compatibility adapters onto the same provider
writes — `/publish` routes through `do_job`/`do_lesson`/`do_report`
themselves, so WP is only one adapter and any second sink receives the
same event. Agents still never call WP REST or hold credentials.

**Event:** `kind` (progress|milestone|report|lesson|news|alert),
`title`, `source` (producer, required), `body` (required for
lesson/report/news), `project`/`job`/`card` refs, `parent`,
`evidence[]` (required for `news`), `confidence`
(observed|measured|verified — `public` news requires `verified`),
`visibility` (private|members|public — **private-first default**),
`audience[]`, `media[]`, `occurred_at`, `event_id`,
`idempotency_key` (auto-derived if absent — identical events dedupe),
`sinks[]` (explicit subset; else kind defaults), `force`, `meta{}`
(provider extras: `job_status`, `topic`, `level`, `report_slug`,
`tg_thread_id`, …).

**Kind → sinks (defaults):**

| kind | sinks | note |
|---|---|---|
| progress | `job`, `board` | heartbeat-class: throttled, never TG |
| milestone | `job`, `board`, `telegram` | |
| report | `report`, `board` | dossier needs `project` slug |
| lesson | `lesson` | Education CPT |
| news | `news`, `board`, `telegram` | evidence required |
| alert | `telegram`, `board`, `job` | |

**Guards:** idempotent on `idempotency_key` (deduped replies carry the
stored receipts); outbox under `~/.local/state/board-api-publish/`
retries failed sinks (30s×2ⁿ ≤30m, dead-letter after 5); capability
checks per sink (`{op:"sinks"}` reports surfaces/kinds/evidence);
noise policy throttles progress per (sink,topic) 15m, telegram floor
10m/topic, identical alerts 60s (`force:true` bypasses noise only —
never visibility); visibility gates sinks by surface class (private →
board+json only; members → +WP private posts/TG; public → +publish
status). Receipts are per-sink `delivered|queued|skipped|suppressed`
with reasons — a `502` still means the door itself failed.

State: `$BOARD_API_PUB_STATE` (default `~/.local/state/board-api-publish/`):
`delivered.json`, `events.jsonl` (ledger), `outbox.jsonl`, `dead.jsonl`,
`noise.json`. Env: `PUB_TELEGRAM_URL`, `PUB_PROGRESS_MIN_S`,
`PUB_TG_MIN_S`, `PUB_ALERT_MIN_S`.
